{{Quote|Gial Gahar?''" [sic]<br />"''Yes. You are?''"<br />"''Lieutenant Strom Dubrok. This craft was seen circling the ''Imperious''.|Strom Dubrok confronting Gial Gahan|<ref name="leg20" />}}
'''Strom Dubrok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], Dubrok was stationed on the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]], where the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']] was under construction. During Dubrok's [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], former [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvir]] [[Gial Gahan]] and his niece, [[Monia Gahan]], made an unauthorized flight around the ''Imperious'' to secretly discuss the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s plans to capture the new [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. When they landed, Dubrok confronted Gial but was manipulated by the former Triumvir, who took Dubrok to speak with the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial base.

==Biography==
{{Quote|That viewing was not authorized!''"<br />"''Come now, lieutenant! I'm fairly certain the ship can stand up to the unauthorized glance of one old politician.|Dubrok and Gial Gahan|<ref name="leg20" />}}
Strom Dubrok was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] during [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Second Imperial Civil War|insurgency]] against the [[One Sith|Sith]]-controlled Empire. In [[137 ABY]], Dubrok was stationed on the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']] was under construction at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants of the Galactic Alliance]] were preparing to launch an attack to capture the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. After former [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvir]] [[Gial Gahan]] and his niece, [[Monia Gahan]], made an unauthorized flight around the ''Imperious''&mdash;during which the pair secretly discussed the Alliance Remnant's plans&mdash;Dubrok confronted Gial as the former Triumvir disembarked from his ship. Gial deflected the Lieutenant, however, and took Dubrok to speak with the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial base, allowing Monia to leave and report to Alliance Remnant commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].<ref name="leg20" />

==Personality and traits==
Strom Dubrok was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Human with dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a light skin tone. When Dubrok attempted to confront Gial Gahan about the unauthorized flight around the ''Imperious'', the former Triumvir was able to manipulate the Lieutenant in order to allow his niece to leave.<ref name="leg20" />

==Equipment==
While serving as a lieutenant, Dubrok donned an olive-colored [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].<ref name="leg20" />

==Behind the scenes==
Strom Dubrok appeared in the twentieth issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, [[Legacy (2006) 20|''Indomitable, Part 1'']],<ref name="leg20" /> released on [[February 27]], [[2008]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-881/Star-Wars-Legacy-20|text=Star Wars: Legacy #20}}</ref> The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="leg20" />
